title: Do Not Build Fortresses to Protect Yourself - Isolation Is Dangerous
hook: Fiona hears the warehouse rumor only after she leaves the protected office.
counterintuition: The obvious move is to trust the label. The stronger move is to read the pressure underneath it and act before isolation turns costly.
tryThisNow: Look at one live situation today and name the visible sign of isolation. Change one sentence, object, or sequence so the safer reading appears first.
keyTakeaway: Stay in circulation so information and adjustment reach you before danger hardens.

breakdown.fastRead:
Mathieu lines up the wrench in the archives. The build choice looks small, yet it can shift focus.

Fear feels fast for Mathieu. It also gives the room a clean target.

Keep fortresses close and plain. One clear act should change what others can do next.

If the wrench move feels false or cruel, narrow it. Power lasts when Mathieu leaves fewer loose ends.
breakdown.deepRead: Heather faces the same pattern in school principal walking lunch duty after relying on reports. The useful distinction is isolation, fortress thinking, information loss. Apply the move through the setup, not through a generic speech.
breakdown.fullRead: Jane sees the limit clearly in hospital administrator joining ambulance handoff rounds. The move helps only when it stays narrower than hiding from every risk. If it becomes a pose, it loses the practical force that made it useful.
